description:
FILED s470bs (Opus) â the one half of #1031 that a runtime change CANNOT
reach, measured rather than assumed.

PERL, probed 5.40.3 (scratch/s470bs/p07-stackov.pl):

    { package OvT; use overload '-X' => sub { push @calls,$_[1]; "-$_[1]" },
                                fallback => 1; }
    my $ft = bless [], 'OvT';
    -r -e     $ft   ->  "-r"   calls=[e,r]
    -e -r     $ft   ->  "-e"   calls=[r,e]
    -r -e -f  $ft   ->  "-r"   calls=[f,e,r]

Every op in the stack gets the OBJECT (innermost first) and the value is the
OUTERMOST's.  perl does this through the op tree (OPpFT_STACKED), not through
`_`.

AND `_` IS GENUINELY UNTOUCHED BY AN OVERLOADED FILETEST (scratch/s470bs/
p08-ovcache.pl):

    stat "/etc/passwd";  -e $ft;  stat _   ->  13 elements, calls=[e]

so the two facts are not reconcilable in a runtime that desugars stacking to
`_`: a bare `_` after an overloaded test must read the PREVIOUS operand, while
a STACKED op after the same test must read the OBJECT.

PCL's lowering (s417, #372) is
    -r -e $ft   ->   (p-&& (p--e $ft) (p--r _))
so `-r` reads whatever `_` held before, and the answer is that, not "-r".

WHAT IT COSTS: 54 rows in t/op/filetest.t -- 27 `stacked overloaded -$op` and
27 `overloaded stacked -$op`, in the 27x14 block.  s470bs's #1031 work
recovered the other ~179 rows of that block (the `-X` handler answering, the
`""` stringification, OverBoth, the GLOB row); these 54 are what is left of it,
plus #1235's 4 IO rows.

FIX SHAPE (untried) -- it is a COMPILER change, which is why s470bs stopped
here (the brief's "a member needing a NEW mechanism stops with its numbers").
The stacked desugaring would have to carry the ORIGINAL operand to each level
rather than `_`, e.g. emit a marker the runtime reads as "the previous
operand's OBJECT if it was overloaded, else the `_` cache".  That is a new
emission shape: generation bump, corpus-diff, the whole Pl/ bar.  Do NOT try to
do it in the runtime alone -- the two probes above prove it cannot be done
there.
subject: A STACKED filetest over an operand with a `-X` overload re-dispatches the HANDLER at every level in perl (`-r -e $ft` calls it with "e" then "r" and answers "-r"); PCL's `_`-chain desugaring reads the stale cache instead.  54 of t/op/filetest.t's rows.
